'''Kway Teow''' was the sprawling [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Felucia]]. The [[Commerce Guild]] had a large presence in the city, with their [[Commerce Guild headquarters|headquarters]] located just outside. Kway Teow was originally built using [[Felucian]] laborers aided financially by [[Gossam]].<ref name="COTR" />
